description: A segment file convention that automatically wraps page.tsx in React Suspense to stream instant fallback UI while async work resolves.
A mandatory 'use client' segment component that catches unexpected runtime errors inside its subtree and provides a reset() function to retry rendering.
A next/navigation helper and segment file that halt rendering on missing records and display a 404 UI without triggering error.tsx.
The fixed Next.js wrapper hierarchy ordering layout, template, error, loading, not-found, and page from outermost to innermost.
